reads.source: Gallica IIIF, native 1914x3121. CALIBRATION: printed corner numbers read FIRST, before any text -- left 183, right 184, running head 'WALAFRIDI STRABI FULD. MON. OPP. PARS I. -- THEOLOGICA.' Crops: left column head (banner + PROTHEMATA head) at 2.2x; left column 0183A body at 2.4x; left column 0183A mid at 4.0x; left column foot 0183D at 2.4x and one line at 6.0x; right column 0184B at 3.0x and 3.4x. No crop crossed the centre gutter.
reads.found: FOUR RESULTS. (1) The book-title banner is confirmed on the plate, set above and across the PROTHEMATA head, with the Hebrew present as type -- it is a display line, not a section head, exactly as the brief states. (2) 0183A prints 'corporalis noster exitus de Aegypto spirituali' -- our twin is correct and the odd word is Migne's; carried as a [cj:], no patch. (3) 0183A prints the genitive plural 'et Hebraeorum liberationum' among accusatives -- Migne's own; rendered literally, no marker. (4) DIVERGENCE: 0183D prints 'et terra te multiplicat in operibus bonis' where our twin has 'et'; patch filed. Also confirmed at 0184B: 'et divictis eis [devicto eo]' with SQUARE brackets, verbatim as our twin -- the second witness's parentheses are its own noise.

reads.source: Gallica IIIF, native 1868x3096. CALIBRATION: printed corner numbers read FIRST -- left 185, right 186, running head 'GLOSSA ORDINARIA. -- LIB. EXOD.' Crops: left column bands A, C and D at 3.2x; right column band D at 3.6x and 4.2x, plus a 9x and a 13x autocontrast crop of a single word. No crop crossed the centre gutter.
reads.found: FOUR RESULTS. (1) 0185A prints 'intra con-' / 'cientiam flagitiosa committere', hyphenated across a line -- 'concientiam' is Migne's own orthography, twin correct; NO [sic:] fired (see cruces). (2) 0185C prints 'Vade retro, Satana' -- 'retro' is on the plate, so the divergence from the Vulgate's 'Vade Satana' is Migne's and a [var:] stands. (3) 0185D prints the whole Jeremias XVII partridge verse verbatim as our twin has it, including 'Clamavit ... congregavit ... derelinquent eum ... erit stultus'; [var:] stands. (4) 0186D is UNDER-INKED at the disputed letter of 'divi?orum' and could not be decided by eye; recorded as a checked-but-undecided letter, marker withdrawn, provisional patch filed.

reads.source: Gallica IIIF, native 1911x3121. CALIBRATION: printed corner numbers read FIRST -- left 189, right 190, running head 'GLOSSA ORDINARIA. -- LIB. EXOD.' reads.found: FIVE RESULTS. (1) DIVERGENCE: 0189C prints 'regalia colloce-' / 'mus' where our twin has 'collecemus'; patch filed. (2) 0189B prints the Romans X quotation verbatim as our twin ('inducam ... concitabo'); [var:] stands. (3) 0189D prints the Jeremias IX quotation verbatim as our twin; [var:] stands. (4) 0190D prints 'Post multum vero temporis, etc' with NO full stop after 'etc' at a line end -- twin correct, mark not supplied in the English. (5) 0190D confirms 'temporis', which is where the brief's Clementine pre-scan flagged a match-only-elsewhere: the Clementine prints the ablative 'tempore'. Recorded, no marker (no sense turns on it, and the comparand's own reading is ungrammatical).

reads.source: Gallica IIIF, native 1903x3115. CALIBRATION: printed corner numbers read FIRST -- left 191, right 192, running head 'WALAFRIDI STRABI FULD. MON. OPP. PARS I. -- THEOLOGICA.' Crops: left column band D at 3.8x; right column bands B and D at 3.4x-3.6x. No crop crossed the centre gutter.
reads.found: THREE RESULTS. (1) DIVERGENCE: 0191D prints 'qua ratione sacerdotes in tabernaculo Dei ministrent' where our twin has 'sacertodes'; patch filed. The same column prints 'sacerdo-' / 'tale' two lines later, giving a same-column control for the letters. (2) 0192B prints 'tanto delectabiliter tenent, quanto quod libuerit, non licet.' verbatim as our twin, comma included -- the positive degree where Gregory has 'delectabilius' is Migne's; declined as a [cj:] under Pattern 18a, logged as a crux. (3) 0192D prints 'In terram bonam et spatiosam, in terra quae fluit lacte, etc.' -- the accusative/ablative shift is really on the plate; twin correct, carried by a [var:].
